entities.name: Jules Marie Armand Cavelier de Cuverville
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jules de Cuverville was a French naval officer who rose to become Chief of Staff of the French Navy. He entered politics in later life, elected to the senate where between 1901 and 1912 he represented Finistère.
